title: 第12章 祁晏辞经济困难？
slug: 前任渣我五年闪婚他哥被宠成宝
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

消息发出去后，他又低头看了那张照片很久。

片刻后，他自嘲地扯了下唇角。

他真是疯了。

照片里的女人穿着高定礼服，脖子上的珠宝在阳光下亮得晃眼。

这一身下来，少说上百万。

怎么可能是时夏禾。

她连买一件一百块的衣服，都要犹豫很久。

又怎么可能穿成这样，站在祁晏辞身边？

很快，对方回了消息。

“不行啊深哥，老爷子今天特意交代了，不许乱传辞哥结婚的事，宴会上也不准往外流照片。谁敢偷拍被抓到，三年都别想再进祁家家宴。刚才这张，还是我躲花坛后面拍的。”

晏瑾深指尖敲了敲手机边缘。

最后只回了一句。

【算了，帮我留意他们。】

发完，他把手机扣在桌上，起身走到落地窗前，抽出一支烟点燃。

烟雾升起，模糊了他的眉眼。

夏家的婚约不能废。

晏家需要这门联姻，才能

可他不想娶。

祁晏辞又偏偏在这个节骨眼上，另娶了别人。

晏家已经没有第二个合适的人，能替他接下这门婚事。

晏瑾深盯着窗外，眸色一点点沉下去。

指间的烟燃到一半，灰烬无声坠落。

他脸色冷得厉害。

另一边，祁家花园。

时夏禾刚被祁念念拉过去，就被一群年轻女孩围住了。

“表嫂，你是哪家的小姐啊？”

“是外省的吗？以前好像没见过你。”

“你跟辞哥怎么认识的？听说你们已经领证了？”

“你这条裙子也太漂亮了吧，哪家的高定？”

“还有这套首饰，好衬你啊。”

七嘴八舌的问题砸过来。

时夏禾一开始还有些紧张。

但纪枫早上给她补过基本信息，她便只挑能说的答。

“我不是本地人，和我先生认识得比较突然。”

“裙子是ElieSaab春夏高定，首饰是Buccellati的Macri系列。”

她语气温和，笑容也恰到好处。

不热络，也不怯场。

倒真有几分新婚太太的从容。

气氛也渐渐轻松下来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After the message was sent, he looked down at the photo for a long time.

After a moment, he twitched the corners of his lips in a self-deprecating tone.

He's really crazy.

The woman in the photo is wearing a high-end dress, and the jewelry around her neck is dazzling in the sun.

This whole body is worth at least a million.

How could it be Shi Xiahe.

She even hesitates for a long time to buy a piece of clothing worth 100 yuan.

How could he be dressed like this and stand next to Qi Yanci?

Soon, the other party responded to the message.

"No, Brother Shen. The old man made a special statement today that no rumors about Brother Ci's marriage are allowed, and photos are not allowed to be leaked outside at the banquet. Anyone who dares to take secret photos and is caught will not be able to enter the Qi family banquet again for three years. I took the picture just now while hiding behind the flower bed."

Yan Jin tapped the edge of the phone with her fingertips.

In the end, he only replied.

[Forget it, keep an eye on them for me.】

After sending it, he put the phone on the table, stood up and walked to the floor-to-ceiling window, took out a cigarette and lit it.

Smoke rose, blurring his features.

The Xia family's engagement cannot be annulled.

The Yan family needs this marriage to

But he doesn't want to marry.

Qi Yanci chose to marry someone else at this juncture.

There is no second suitable person in the Yan family who can take over this marriage for him.

Yan Jin stared deeply out of the window, his eyes darkening little by little.

The smoke between the fingers was halfway burned, and the ashes fell silently.

His face was extremely cold.

On the other side, Qi Family Garden.

As soon as Shi Xiahe was pulled over by Qi Niannian, he was surrounded by a group of young girls.

"Cousin, which family are you from?"

"Are you from another province? I don't think I've seen you before."

"How do you and Brother Ci know each other? I heard that you have already received your certificates?"

"This dress of yours is so beautiful, isn't it? Which haute couture shop is it from?"

"And this set of jewelry, it looks great on you."

Questions came flooding in.

Shi Xiahe was a little nervous at first.

But Ji Feng gave her some basic information in the morning, so she only answered what she could tell.

"I'm not a local, and I met my husband quite suddenly."

"The skirt is ElieSaab spring and summer haute couture, and the jewelry is Buccellati's Macri series."

Her tone was gentle and her smile was just right.

Not enthusiastic or stage frightened.

She really has the calmness of a newlywed lady.

The atmosphere gradually became more relaxed.
